title: β-caryolane derivatives as novel anti-colorectal cancer agents: synthesis and in vitro biological evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49739-49750
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07312J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xingjun Xu, Zhiwei Wang, Anjie Huang, Zhongjing Qiao, Yonglin Ge, Hui Wen, Junxiang Cheng, Yaopeng Zhao, Xinmiao Liang
Novel β-caryolane derivatives were synthesized via acid catalysis. Compound NC-19 exhibited anti-CRC activity by arresting the cell cycle at the G0/G1 phase, elevating intracellular ROS levels, and thereby inducing apoptosis.
